# Get All Values from Dictionary

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Get all of the values from a dictionary.

## Syntax

~~~~text
valuesFrom(dictionary: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
valuesFrom(dictionary: Meta)
~~~~
